metaTitle: Custom Throws Table Displays | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom throws table displays for trade shows. Full-color printing, multiple sizes. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom throws table displays offer a cost-effective way to transform plain banquet tables into branded marketing surfaces. Unlike fitted cloths, throws drape over the front and sides, providing a large imprint area for logos and messaging. Choose from standard sizes like 2' x 4', 2' x 6', or 2' x 8' to match your table dimensions. Full-color dye sublimation printing ensures vibrant, washable graphics that hold up through multiple events. Ideal for trade shows, job fairs, and registration tables where first impressions matter.
